## Proposal and provenance

Stable algorithm slug: `epoch-conditioned-evidence-confidence`. Source: pm-4k6b note recorded 2026-08-08T22:00:52.713Z.

Context relevance ledger (32): epoch-conditioned evidence confidence — discount a record's recorded measurements by whether the contract that produced them is still the contract that would be applied to read them.

Recorded 2026-08-08. Extends the ledger; entries 1 through 31 stand.

The observation this is derived from. A correct refusal blocked the daily cut because the event predated the tag producer the gate reads, so the gate could not judge it and failed closed. Generalized on the roadmap as horizon AH. The relevance consequence is separate from the gate consequence and is what this entry captures: when the engine assembles context, it currently treats every recorded measurement as equally citable, whether it was written under the contracts in force today or under contracts that have since been replaced. An agent handed a number extracted from a record written three epochs ago will reason about it as though it were current, and the record gives it no way to know otherwise.

What the signal computes. For each candidate item, determine the contract epoch under which its recorded evidence was written — the schema version, error-code catalog version, dependency-kind lexicon, and projection contract in force at its write timestamps — and compare that to the epoch in force now. The signal is a scalar in the unit interval: one when the item's evidence was written entirely under the current epoch, decaying toward a floor as the number of intervening contract changes that touch fields the item actually carries increases. Weighting is by touched field, not by elapsed time: an item whose only recorded fields are ones no contract change has altered is not discounted at all, however old it is, and an item written last week under a since-replaced projection is.

Why it is a relevance signal and not a validity check. It never asserts that old evidence is wrong. Old evidence is usually right, and the immutable record is the reason the project can be trusted at all. It asserts only that old evidence is less safe to quote without re-derivation, which is exactly the judgement a ranking engine exists to make. In assembly it should surface as an explainable per-signal component, so a bounded context can say why a fresher but less central item outranked an older, more central one.

Degeneracy clauses, mandatory as for every entry in this ledger. On a corpus with exactly one contract epoch — any newly initialized workspace, and any project that has never changed a contract — the signal is identically one for every item and the ranking is byte-identical to the ranking without it. On a two-item corpus it is likewise identically one. The signal can only ever discount, never promote, so it cannot manufacture confidence in an item and cannot raise any ceiling; the worst case it can produce is a ranking that is uniformly one epoch conservative. If epoch metadata is unavailable for an item the signal returns one rather than a penalty, so an unmeasurable item is never demoted for being unmeasurable.

Relationship to neighbouring entries. Distinct from (26) recurrence-conditioned retrieval priors, which conditions on how often a family recurs; this conditions on whether the vocabulary the evidence is written in still applies. Distinct from (23) citation-stable evidence addressing, which asks whether a citation still resolves; this asks whether a citation that does resolve still means what it said. It composes with (31), contract-seam staleness: (31) ranks the pair whose two sides were last edited in different changes, and this entry ranks the record written before either edit.

Candidate only. It requires an epoch representation that does not exist yet, which is horizon AH's terminal answer, so it must be routed through that work and must not be weighted on the strength of one incident. Reference evidence: pm-h75tjh.

Scope clarification from individual-ownership review: pm-h75tjh owns a related measurement, read primitive or defect fix. It does not independently deliver this proposed ranking behavior. Reuse its evidence and public API; evaluate the additional behavior in this experiment.

## Delivery boundary

Evaluate this mechanism as a bounded public-SDK experiment before any production adoption. Use the existing scorer and packer contracts; no CLI-only behavior or new command noun. The historical catalog is design input, not evidence that this mechanism was implemented.

## Experiment protocol

Freeze a workspace/history revision and parameter manifest. Compare against the current deterministic SDK baseline using held-out judgments and negative controls. Report nDCG/action success, critical-evidence omission, latency p50/p95, peak memory, tokens per completed task, and rebuild cost separately. Include 3-item/minutes, real-shaped, 100k/1M-item, decades-long, and sparse/dense/imbalanced graph scenarios; smoke subsets may not claim scale acceptance. Bound candidate counts, graph expansions, elapsed time, and output size, with cancellation and completeness receipts. Record exact versus approximate behavior and approximation error; theoretical guarantees require their stated assumptions. Missing or untrusted evidence remains unknown, never inferred proof.

Promotion requires a reproducible quality improvement on the held-out target population, no regression of existing exact invariants or mandatory gates, and a declared compute/token cost justified by that improvement. Reject or defer with the same immutable evidence if those conditions fail. No production default, adaptive learning, or data export is authorized by this planning item.
